sentences.text: Learned Government Advocate for the re hand, has opposed the bail application by submitting that no sufficient ground is made out for releasing the applicant on bail, both the courts below have convicted the petitioner rightly after considering the material available on record, hence the application filed by the applicant be dismissed.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, the quantum of sentence imposed upon the applicant, this Court is of the considered opinion that the application for suspension of jail sentence filed on behalf of the applicant deserves to be allowed.

Accordingly, I.A.No.11727/2022 is allowed and it is directed that on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, the execution of jail sentence of the applicant shall remain suspended,
till the final disposal of this revision for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 18.11.2022 and thereafter on all such subsequent dates, as may be SAN AMIT KUMAR Date:
